HOW TO BOOK 💜

✨Custom-Design Anfrage 
Möchtest du eine eigene Idee mit mir umsetzen, dann schicke deine Anfrage bitte über mein Kontaktformular auf meiner Website noirnu.de.
Einfach den Link BOOKING nutzen. Du kannst als Inspo auch Bilder im Anfrageformular anhängen. Ich bin so gespannt auf eure Ideen!
Nach dem Eingang der Anfrage wird Doro Slots für eine telefonische Beratung vorschlagen. Die ist maximal eine halbe Stunde angesetzt. 

💡 Wannados-Anfrage
Bitte den Titel und oder Nummer mit angeben, Dann kann ich euch eine Preiskalkulation schicken.(gleicher Buchungslink wie für Custom). Wähle dann Wannados statt Custom aus. Für Wannados gibt es keine Beratung, da das Motiv da schon fest steht. 

Wie immer gilt: Ich steche jedes Design nur einmal!
First come, first serve. (Manche Flash sheets sind forever designs, die steche ich mehrmals. Steht dann aber dabei. 

WENN BOOKS OPEN: Doro und ich werden dann in den folgenden 1-2Wochen alle eure Anfragen sichten und bearbeiten. Deshalb bitte ich um ein wenig Geduld. Je nach der Menge der Anfragen, kann es einfach etwas dauern. 
Aber ich kenn euch doch schon etwas besser! Ihr seid einfach die coolsten und emphatisch und verständnisvoll.

❓Any questions left? Dann schreib sie hier bitte in die Kommentare oder schau mal bei dem bookings Info Story Highlight vorbei. 

Wenn du mehr über meine Preisgestaltung erfahren möchtest, findest du genauere Infos unter noirnu.de im Bereich FAQ. 

Bussi, 
Eure Natalie

DYFKd4JI1pL.content:
🚨Warum AI „Kunst“ problematisch ist und ich sie jetzt schon nicht mehr sehen kann.

💜Ich bin Künstlerin – ich erschaffe meine eigenen Werke. Warum sollte ich einfach copy-pasten, was eine Maschine mir ausspuckt? Ein Tattoo ist mehr als ein Bild auf Haut. Es ist Handwerk, Seele und Absicht.
Und lass uns kurz ehrlich sein – AI-„Kunst” hat ein paar ernste Probleme:
⚠️ Diebstahl ohne Einwilligung – KI-Modelle werden auf den Werken echter Künstler trainiert, ohne deren Erlaubnis oder Vergütung.
⚠️ Kein Urheberrecht – AI-generierte Bilder gehören rechtlich niemandem – und können nicht wirklich geschützt werden.
⚠️ Keine Aussage – Eine KI kennt keinen Schmerz, keine Freude, keine Geschichte. Was sie produziert, ist leer.
⚠️ Entwertung von echtem Handwerk – Wenn Kunden AI-Outputs als Vorlage bringen, wird jahrelange Ausbildung und Können auf einen Klick reduziert.
⚠️ Irreführung – Vieles, was als „Kunst” verkauft wird, ist generiert – und das wird oft nicht kommuniziert.
Meine Kunst kommt aus mir. Und das wirst du auf deiner Haut spüren. 🖤🪡

UND! Stell dir vor du möchtest richtige Anpassungen der AI Vorlage… dein „ARTIST“ wirds womöglich nicht richtig hinbekommen, wenns nicht selbst gestaltet ist…

VERSTEHE: Der Unterschied zwischen Tattoo Artist und Tätowierer*in ist Kunstwerke selbst zu gestalten und nicht einfach nur fremde Vorlagen zu kopieren (was strafbar ist, außer bei AI).

NUTZT KI um schneller ne E-Mail zu schreiben, nicht als tattoo Vorlage. Frag Deinen Future artist, ob eigene Designs erstellt werden. Leider verzichten viele auf die verpflichtende Kennzeichnung.

Du willst ein echtes Kunstwerk auf deiner Haut, mit Kreativität, ganz einzigartig, nur für dich gestaltet?
Dann bist du hier genau richtig ✨

Hey, schön dass du da bist! 🖤 Ich möchte dir einen kleinen Einblick geben, wie ich arbeite – und welche Stile ich in meinem kreativen Schaffen vereine.
Gestartet bin ich 2018 als reine Fineline Artist. Heute bewege ich mich zwischen:
✦ Fineline · Black Work · Microrealism
✦ Illustrative · Abstract · Geometrical Art
Ob kleine, feine Projekte oder komplette Körperkonzepte – ich arbeite mit Mischtechniken, kombiniere Stencil mit Freehand, feine Linien mit dunklen Flächen, Negativformen, geometrischen und floralen Elementen.
Ein neues Element sind meine BRUSH STROKES – digital oder direkt mit dem Pinsel auf dem Körper. Und seit einer Weile liebe ich es, Ohrkonzepte zu gestalten, die ich liebevoll EAR CANDY nenne. 🌸
Meine Arbeit soll fließen – ganz natürlich mit dem Körper.

it is interesting how mental health issues manifest themselves. it can all start with a self depricating comment that quickly spirals down to self loathing. or a life altering experience that destroys the current perception. or as simple as always having an overwhelming fear of...life. the hardest part is not only assessing these traits in oneself, but accepting them and kneading them so that they don't succumb "reality". the hardest part is being self aware and understanding how they are physically and mentally affecting oneself. it is understanding how the mental distortion projects to the outside world. 
being self aware of ones mental complexities allows us to see them in others. this is important. this is important because we can be the difference in a person; we can help others. this is important because mental health issues are not discussed as often as they should, which can end a sentence much sooner than it should be. this is important because it allows us connect try to get a grasp of the human experience in a conducive way.

this semicolon, the continuation of a sentence, is a symbol of my support to all those I know going through mental struggles. i am here, always, for you, cause the mind is our permanet home. 👫👬👭 thank you @spencerkinnardtattoos for the delicate tattoo!

Too much light, too much light to be truly dark.

DUb5WLcj6YP.content:
They inspire me to be a better person. ❤️ Disrespect sickens me, it only leads one way and it ain't up. 

There was a time when it felt harder to tell good from evil. That doesn’t feel true right now. Political labels don’t really help here — Democrat, Republican, Independent, or Jedi. None of that gets to the heart of it. What matters is how we respond when we’re faced with hatred, violence, or harm.

When racism shows up — in thought, in systems, in speech, in action — it needs to be resisted. Quietly or publicly, internally and externally, but resisted all the same. And the truth needs to be spoken: every person carries inherent dignity. We’re all made in the image of something sacred, whether we name it that way or not. Anything that denies that dignity creates places where damage thrives. Most of us know those places. We’ve all spent time in corners of the world — or of ourselves — that feel impossible to clean up.

Still, we have a choice about how we move through the world. We can lead with love and light, even when it’s difficult. Especially when it’s difficult. It’s harder when we’re tangled up in fear or greed or self-protection — but it’s not impossible. We can do better tomorrow than we did today. And we don’t have to walk that road alone. 

We as a people are better than this. And we can do better. 

Sorry for the sermon, thank you for reading this. 🦋❤

 #greed #obama #michelleobama #hope #peace #light #wethepeople #truth

DUjxUh7jNxI.content:
Today I walked through an old cemetery on a hill overlooking one of the three rivers that hold this place. Sunlight touched the emerald water below, and the light danced.

One grave stood taller than the rest, marked with a Confederate flag. My brother. A stranger. Someone who died for a cause he may not have chosen. Was he like my own ancestor—who fought for the South in place of a rich man? Was he a survivor too? My ancestor was captured by the North, changed his name, and fought for the North until the war was over, when he came home alive. He didn’t care much about causes. He was too poor.

I’m lucky. I get to live my life for a purpose, not a cause. I’m given time—to understand it, to hold it, to lay it down, and to take it up again with care. I don’t think the man beneath that tall stone had the same choices.

But the river keeps moving. The light keeps finding the water. And I get to keep choosing how I live. I’m glad he has the river. And I’m grateful I can walk past his grave and let the beauty pass through me—reminding me that even here, even now, life keeps offering itself. And every day, I am part of a story still being written.

DVKUwFVj-Th.content:
Heart rot. One of the many things that can happen to a fruit tree after it's struck by lightning. I'm saying goodbye to my sweet little peach tree that gave me the best fruit ever until lightning struck it 7 years ago. Even with all my pruning and best attempts, the fruit just rots on the vine. It doesn't have the heart to make the fruit anymore. But the flowers, they are really what its all about. Blooming. It's what comes natural. And I hope the next homeowner realizes that this little traumatized tree is still doing more than its job. It brings beauty into the world, and shade and pollen. And every day, it is still cleansing this dirty air. Over and above. 

Life isn't always about bearing good fruit. Sometimes, all we can do is go through the seasons and just enjoy the cycles. It's enough to bloom, and grow and fade. It's enough to exist planted in the ground, soaking in the sun, making the world around us a bit more lovely. 🍑

One of the most chronic feelings of our time is this quiet ache of being unseen.

We’re all here—posting, sharing, curating moments from our lives—yet somehow still feeling unobserved, unheard, unknown in the ways that matter most.

But lately, I’ve been discovering a different kind of seeing.

Not from an audience. Not from an algorithm.
But from life itself. 

I've been slowing down enough to notice the way clean air feels in my lungs… the way something deep inside me softens when I stop trying to be visible and just be.

And in that slower, more intentional pace, I’m beginning to feel it—this quiet, beautiful sense of being held, known, and seen… understanding that life has been pouring itself into me all along. 

We pour ourselves into so many people and projects nonstop, it's just good to slow down and realize life's got us. And we can let life pour into us for a while. 🦋🎸

Let’s talk about something slightly boring… but extremely important.

✨ Consent forms ✨

(And there is a code for you below)

I know. Not the coolest topic in tattooing 🙄
But tattooing involves skin, health information, legal responsibility… and as you know, and are often not happy about, content creation too. 😅

A proper consent form should clearly mention:
✔️ the tattoo procedure
✔️ medical information
✔️ aftercare responsibility
✔️ and ofc photos, videos, social media, promotional or educational use

‼️Because if you’re recording, photographing, or posting clients, that needs to be written and signed. No gray area zone here‼️

Beyond the legal aspect, consent forms do something bigger.
They make your space feel professional!
Clients feel safer when everything is clear. You, also, definitely feel safer when everything is documented.

Now, you guys know I don’t randomly talk about apps. I’m very picky about tools.

However I had a chance to chat with the team at @wavrr.app recently, and I genuinely liked what they’re building.

It’s a digital consent form system made for tattoo artists.
👉 You can send forms before the appointment, collect signatures online, store everything in one place, and they support multiple languages too (English, German, Turkish, Dutch, Spanish and French).

Let me know if you have further questions about your consent forms, and definitely check out @wavrr.app

DRF8SGHD2Ry.content:
Thank you to every department and firefighter who responded for mutual aid and backfill during the Greystone fire. Your support ensured our city stayed protected while our crews worked a difficult and unfortunate incident.

We want the Wilmington community and the owners of The Greystone to know that we truly feel for everyone impacted. The circumstances of this fire were not what any of us ever want to see in our city.

This incident also highlights the reality of our current staffing model. With a minimum of 3 firefighters on an apparatus, we often end up with only 2 advancing hose and 2–3 searching. Our crews give everything they have, but this setup slows down critical tasks that directly affect rescue and fire control.

Achieving the NFPA-recommended minimum of 4 firefighters per apparatus is essential. Proper staffing makes hose advancement more efficient, speeds up searches, and improves overall safety for both the community and our firefighters.

Local 129 will continue making this a top priority, working with elected officials and city administration to secure the staffing our city needs.

Thank you again to all who answered the call. 🚒🔥💛

@pffp_nc @iaffofficial @wectnews @wwaynews @foxwilmington @cityofwilm @explorewilmingtonnc @wilmingtontoday @starnewsonline @wilmington_chamber #nfpa #staffing #iaff #pffpnc #wilmington #greystone

DRKJJJID0Cf.content:
🚒 Why 4-Person Engine Companies Matter

When an engine company is fully staffed with four firefighters, we can operate the way modern fireground tactics are designed — faster, safer, and more effective for the community we protect.

🔥 On Arrival:
	•One firefighter can immediately pump the truck and secure a water supply, ensuring continuous, reliable water.
	•The officer can complete a 360° size-up, identify hazards, and make a sound game plan.
	•The other two firefighters deploy the attack line without delay.

🏠 Inside the Structure:
With four on the engine, the crew can push inside as a coordinated team.
	•Three firefighters advance the hose together deep into a dark, smoke-filled structure.
	•The officer maintains supervision, accountability, and direction, using the thermal imaging camera (TIC) to guide the team toward fire and potential victims.

👨‍👩‍👧 For the Community:
Four-person staffing means:
	•Faster fire attack, slowing fire growth and reducing property loss
	•Quicker searches for trapped occupants
	•More controlled, safer operations, reducing the chance of fire spread to neighboring homes
	•Better outcomes for citizens who depend on us in their worst moments

✔️ Bottom Line:
Four-person engines don’t just make operations safer for firefighters — they make our entire community safer. This is the standard our citizens deserve.

DSZ5MxjDdmF.content:
🔥 BIG WIN FOR FIREFIGHTERS 🔥

The U.S. Senate has passed the HONOR Act, officially recognizing firefighter cancer as a line-of-duty death under federal benefits.

This is a direct result of the relentless advocacy of your IAFF, fighting for years to make sure firefighters lost to occupational cancer are honored the same as those lost on the fireground, and that their families receive the benefits they deserve.

Cancer is the leading cause of firefighter line-of-duty deaths.
This law acknowledges that reality, and it honors the sacrifice.

This is why we advocate.
This is why we stand together.
This is why your IAFF matters. 🔥✊

DR_6e7TjHy6.content:
We went from Pinterest to AI, and let’s please drop both. 

I used to receive plenty of tattoo requests with people looking for references going through the artwork by other tattooers. Now more and more people start using AI to pre-design their idea to show me what they mean. 

And I get it. For people who don’t work with visuals, it seems impossible to explain what you have in mind, and you feel like you need help to sort out your messy thoughts and fluff it all up before you share it with me, your tattoo artist.

But you are not helping. First of all, your raw ideas and inner mess is key for me: it can lead to an unexpected decisions and twists, I might notice something the chat gpt would miss, and I will get ahold of it, and we will build something even more interesting together. 

You think you can’t explain it but you can, and I, a human, will understand you better than any machine ever will. 

You might be worried that you are wasting my time, and through fixing the design with ai you are making shortcuts, but working with you on the design is a huge and a very important part of my job. I love it. I love creating for you, with you. I love making alterations and always leave room for some changes. 

The most dangerous part though is: you ask AI to draw a pre sketch just to explain your idea. But then. Without understanding it. You get attached to it. And all the changes you later ask me to make in my design are your subconscious attempts to get my design closer to what AI built for you. Not because you like it more. Because it feels familiar now. 

Please, please don’t do it. Leave the artistic part to your artist. If you like my art, trust me. Use my older artwork as a reference. Send me pictures of the alive creatures or objects you mean (that old grandma’s chair, your silly goofy dog). Let me do my job. Let’s put some time and communication into it. I will not disappoint.

DVnRO3jDAqB.content:
I identify as a woman, despite struggling with this concept all my life. I didn’t like my shapes and curves, my breasts, since quite early age I was mocked for having “udders,” then for having hair on my legs. I had extremely painful cramps, but I was shamed by my (female) school gym teacher for being weak, so I had to suck it up. I was scared that someone would hear my pad make a noise, god forbid see me leak through. I was so ashamed of how I was. So I was trying to fit in. I did all of it: make up, nails, I shaved everything I could, I was trying so hard to find a way to look like a real woman. 

Only years and years later I found out that actually being a real woman doesn’t require you to be anything other than what you want to be. 

You can be classy and chic, wearing heals and red lipstick even when going to a grocery shop. You might as well shave your head before an important event and wear snickers and no bra under an oversized hoodie. You can be both. 

You can run like a girl: fast and strong. You can run like a girl: slow and steady. You can also just not run - equally like a girl. 

You can be tiny, you can be big, you can be soft, you can be stronger than any gym bro you know. 

You can work or not, have kids or not, get married to whom you want, or not. 

I am lucky to have amazing strong smart gorgeous women around me whom I call friends. Running world known media, designing clothes that is being worn all over the globe, operating tattoo shops that host thousands of people who feel safe there, raising kids, working in healthcare and IT. There are women who support me, there are women who inspire me, there are women who are my role models. 

Here’s to all of you. All of us. If you, as well as myself, identify as a woman: I see you. I am here for you. Here’s to the sisterhood. To the girl power. To the world that we are building. Where all people are enough as they are, where all people are safe, all have equal respect and equal rights.

DYOQM-1syOP.content:
It wasn’t an easy year. But it was indeed a beautiful one. A powerful one. I have grown as a person, as a mom, as an artist, as an entrepreneur. I laughed and made people laugh, I bought flowers and books and put a silly little notes into the lunchbox of my little human. I cried and hurt, but also I learned to heal and move on. I cooked and was cooked for, I said good night in multiple languages all over the world. I went on the wandering adventures with humans and dogs, I started and finished races. I tried, failed, tried again, again, and again, mostly eventually succeeding. I smiled to animals, birds and bugs, I sent days worth of voice notes to people I care about. I fell in love and got heartbroken. I learned to accept that there are things I can’t control, but also learned that it’s necessary to reject the things I don’t want, and built the life I love living everyday. This year has introduced me to myself, and showed me the reasons to be proud. And I have never been muchier. The thing is, I adore my muchness now, and will never hide or belittle it again. 

Bring it on, new year. I am ready to roll on ❤️‍🔥
